notes: The author scopes this build to the lobby only, so the layout job is a hub whose purpose is to send visitors onward, not the zombie wave defense game itself; Survival is named second because that game and its barricade-and-ammo-crate dressing are what the lobby is for. The Hub preset lands almost unchanged — the central Create Room portal is the teleporter marker and the focal build the author asked to make the centrepiece, and the hall around it is the gathering space — with spawn-first-reveal added for the clear player spawn zone the prompt lists. Overrode the P4 that hub-portals normally carries, which the genre notes allow when the portal is not a transition into another zone of this build: the author answered that it teleports nowhere yet and is a placeholder trigger, so this is a single-zone P0 layout with a marker in it. With no user to ask, I took the compact single hall from the scale answer and treated the retro blocky styling, the GUI menu and the third-person controls as non-layout.
